summary:
Agri — Field Shift is a web-based decision-support tool that helps farmers assess crop rotation options using real environmental and soil data. Developed for the Field Shift challenge, it uses NASA POWER climate data to evaluate rainfall reliability, heat exposure, and frost risk, alongside SoilGrids data to provide soil context. Farmers can compare supported crop rotations and explore evidence-based results for their selected analysis year and growing season.

The platform presents data coverage, source references, and confidence levels so users can understand how reliable each assessment is. Satellite imagery provides additional visual context rather than being treated as numerical evidence. By making scientific data easier to explore, Agri — Field Shift aims to support more informed agricultural planning and help farmers consider how environmental conditions affect crop rotation decisions.
details:
How It Works
Agri — Field Shift is a web-based decision-support platform that helps farmers explore crop rotation options using environmental and soil data. Users can select their farm location, growing season, and analysis year, then compare supported crop rotations through assessments of rainfall reliability, heat exposure, soil conditions, and seasonal frost risk.

The platform uses NASA POWER climate data and SoilGrids soil data, along with other integrated agricultural and environmental sources. Its decision engine evaluates available evidence and presents results with data coverage, source references, and confidence levels. When the available evidence is insufficient, the platform communicates this limitation instead of generating unsupported recommendations. Satellite imagery provides additional visual context.

Benefits & Intended Impact

The main benefit is making complex scientific and environmental data easier to understand and use during agricultural planning. Its intended impact is to support more informed crop rotation decisions and help farmers consider changing environmental conditions.

Tools & Technologies

We developed the platform using React, TypeScript, Vite, Node.js, Express, and Supabase. We also integrated data services including NASA POWER, SoilGrids, and NASA GIBS.

Creativity & Key Considerations

The creative aspect of our project is bringing multiple environmental data sources together in one practical workflow while making evidence quality and limitations visible. We considered data reliability, source transparency, usability, supported crop rotations, and the importance of avoiding misleading conclusions.
